title: Radar scanner

screen.calibrateHint: Draw the box where the scan shows the radar signature
screen.setup: Scan a rock or a wreck, then calibrate by drawing a box around the signature number the scan shows. Keep the same camera position afterwards.
screen.calibrationFound: Box saved: {value} was read in it.
screen.calibrationEmpty: Box saved, but no number was read in it. Check that it covers the scan's signature.
screen.tooSmall: Box too small: draw it a little wider around the number.
screen.unreadable: No signature read: nothing is scanned, or something covers the box, this window included.

context.label: Where are you scanning?
context.hint: Puts first what you can meet where you scan: 4000 is an asteroid from a ship, a deposit from a ROC.

waiting: Waiting for a signature: turn screen reading on, or type the value.

source.network: Signatures up to date from Nexus Tools.
source.cache: Offline: signatures kept from the last connection.
source.builtin: Offline: signatures built into the app (patch 4.10.3).
